title: 第十三章 东窗事发柳氏初失势第十四章 执掌中馈权暗流仍未歇
lines: 摄政王府的马车稳稳停在相府正门，暮色初垂，落霞染遍朱红廊柱。
沈清鸢掀帘下车，一身素雅裙裳不染半分狼狈，眉眼沉静从容。府中下人早已听闻海棠宴风波，个个垂首屏息，看向她的眼神满是敬畏。从前人人笑话的痴傻嫡女，如今凭一己之力破局，反将太子与庶母一脉狠狠碾压。
她刚踏入内院，老夫人身边的嬷嬷便匆匆赶来，恭敬躬身：“大小姐，老夫人在正堂等候，请您即刻过去。”
沈清鸢心中了然，缓步去往正厅。
此刻正堂气氛沉凝压抑，沈敬山端坐主位，脸色铁青，周身怒气几乎压不住。方才海棠宴的风声早已传遍京城，太子当众构陷相府嫡女，此事骇人听闻，他身为丞相，颜面扫地之余，更是后怕不已。
柳氏与沈轻柔被传唤至此，双双跪在冰凉青砖上，发髻散乱、面色惨白，再无往日半点温婉娇俏。
见沈清鸢进门，老夫人当即招手，语气带着疼惜：“鸢儿过来，今日委屈你了。”
一句话落下，柳氏肩头猛地一颤，彻底没了辩驳的底气。
沈敬山怒拍桌案，茶杯震得哐当作响，目光死死盯住柳氏：“事到如今，你还敢隐瞒？东宫为何无端在海棠宴设局害鸢儿？若非你暗中勾结太子、私递密信，怎会闹出这般惊天丑闻！”
他为官数十年，心思通透，稍加串联便彻彻底底想明白了前因后果。
先前柳氏百般阻拦沈清鸢赴宴、执意让沈轻柔随行，后又莫名联络东宫，桩桩件件，都是蓄谋已久的算计。为了扶持自己女儿上位，败坏嫡女名声，不惜勾结储君、构陷自家人，简直蛇蝎心肠。
柳氏浑身发抖，伏地落泪，字字泣血狡辩：“老爷！妾身冤枉！妾身从未勾结东宫，更不敢蓄意加害大小姐，此事全是太子一己之念，与妾身无关啊！”
事已至此，她仍心存侥幸，妄图蒙混过关。只要咬死不认，无凭无据，沈敬山便无法重罚她。
一旁的沈轻柔更是哭得上气不接下气，蜷缩在地，一副惶恐无助的模样，想靠着柔弱博取几分怜悯。
沈清鸢立在堂中，静静看着母女二人垂死挣扎，唇角勾起一抹微凉弧度：“姨娘当真清白？”
她缓缓开口，声音清浅却掷地有声：“海棠宴前两日，你屏退左右亲笔写密信，遣心腹管家从后角门密送东宫，求太子在宴席设计毁我名声、扶持轻柔上位。此事府中后巷扫地仆役、守门小厮皆有目睹，姨娘还要狡辩吗？”
字字句句，精准戳破柳氏所有伪装。
老夫人本就心知柳氏心性狭隘、野心深重，听完这话，眼底最后一丝宽容彻底散尽，眸光冷厉：“柳氏！老夫念你入府多年、养育幼女，屡屡包容退让，没想到你如此不知悔改，心怀歹毒，屡次暗害嫡长！”
“相府容不下你这般阴毒妇人！”
沈敬山怒火攻心，当即沉声下令：“即日起，撤去柳氏管家权，禁足凝香院，不许踏出院门半步！所有贴身下人尽数调离，严加看管，等候发落！”
一声令下，尘埃落定。
柳氏瞬间面如死灰，双腿一软瘫跪在地，不敢置信地抬头：“老爷！不可啊！妾身知错了，求老爷宽恕！”
她执掌相府中馈多年，早已习惯权柄在手的风光，一旦被禁足夺权，便成了笼中困兽，再无翻身余地。往后她在相府便是任人拿捏，再无算计沈清鸢的资本。
可沈敬山心意已决，再不肯多看她一眼。
下人立刻上前，押起哭嚎不止的柳氏与沈轻柔，强行带回凝香院锁禁。
看着二人狼狈离去的背影，沈清鸢心底毫无波澜。
这只是开始。
前世柳氏害她生母惨死、夺她嫁妆、毁她一生、连累沈家满门覆灭，区区禁足夺权，根本抵不上分毫罪孽。
老夫人望着沉静淡然的嫡孙女，满心感慨，轻声安抚：“鸢儿，往后府中家事，祖母替你盯着，再无人敢欺你。”
“多谢祖母。”沈清鸢屈膝道谢。
正厅风波落幕，夜色渐浓。
汀兰院灯火通明，春桃端来温热羹汤，满脸欣喜：“小姐，柳姨娘被夺权禁足，往后咱们再也不用受她拿捏了！而且京中人人都在议论，太子此次行事阴私龌龊，陛下定然不会轻饶！”
沈清鸢端起汤盏，轻轻吹开热气，眸底幽深平静。
她知晓，太子萧景煜的储君之位，经此一事，已然摇摇欲坠。
而远在皇宫，深夜烛火通明。
帝王看着手中呈上的奏折，听完侍卫禀报海棠宴全部始末，龙颜震怒，一掌拍碎案上玉盏。
“荒唐！身为储君，心胸狭隘，阴私歹毒，蓄意构陷朝臣嫡女，丢尽皇家颜面！”
当夜圣旨拟下：太子萧景煜德行有亏，禁足东宫，闭门思过三月，罚俸一年，彻查东宫所有私蓄人手！
消息连夜传遍京城，朝野震动。
所有人都明白，这一次，太子是真的栽了。
而风光翻盘、步步为营的相府嫡女沈清鸢，自此彻底改写了人人可欺的卑微命运。
content_en:
The carriage of the Prince Regent's Palace was parked steadily at the main entrance of the Prime Minister's Palace. Dusk was beginning to fall, and the setting sun dyed the vermilion pillars all over.
Shen Qingyuan lifted the curtain and got out of the car. She was dressed in a simple and elegant dress that was not stained, and her eyes were calm and calm. The servants in the mansion had already heard about the incident at the Begonia Banquet. They all lowered their heads and held their breaths, looking at her with awe in their eyes. The stupid legitimate daughter who was everyone's joke in the past has now broken through the situation on her own and crushed the prince and concubine's lineage.
As soon as she stepped into the inner courtyard, the nanny beside the old lady hurried over and bowed respectfully: "Miss, the old lady is waiting in the main hall. Please come over immediately."
Shen Qingyuan understood clearly and walked slowly to the main hall.
At this moment, the atmosphere in the main hall was solemn and depressing. Shen Jingshan was sitting in the main seat, his face was ashen, and the anger around him could hardly be suppressed. The news of the Haitang Banquet had already spread throughout the capital. The prince framed the prime minister's legitimate daughter in public. This incident was shocking. As the prime minister, he was disgraced and was even more frightened.
Liu and Shen Qingrou were summoned here. They both knelt on the cold blue bricks. Their hair was messy and their faces were pale. They were no longer gentle and charming as before.
Seeing Shen Qingyuan enter the door, the old lady immediately waved her hand, her tone was full of pity: "Yuan'er, come here, I have wronged you today."
After finishing her sentence, Ms. Liu's shoulders trembled suddenly, and she completely lost the confidence to argue.
Shen Jingshan slapped the table angrily, his tea cup clattering, and he stared at Mrs. Liu: "How dare you hide it now? Why did the East Palace set up a trap at the Haitang Banquet to harm Yuan'er for no reason? If you hadn't secretly colluded with the prince and delivered the secret letter privately, how could such a shocking scandal have happened!"
He has been an official for decades and has a clear mind. With a little connection, he can completely understand the cause and effect.
Previously, Liu had tried every possible means to prevent Shen Qingyuan from attending the banquet and insisted on letting Shen Qingrou accompany him. Later, she contacted the East Palace inexplicably. Everything was a long-planned plan. In order to support his daughter's rise to power and ruin the reputation of his legitimate daughter, he did not hesitate to collude with the crown prince and frame his own family. He was simply vicious.
Mrs. Liu was trembling all over, lying on the ground in tears, crying and arguing: "Master! I am wronged! I have never colluded with the East Palace, let alone deliberately harmed the eldest lady. This matter is all the prince's own thoughts and has nothing to do with me!"
Now that the matter has come to this, she still takes chances and tries to muddle through. As long as she refuses to admit it and has no evidence, Shen Jingshan will not be able to punish her severely.
Shen Qingrou on the side was crying so hard that she was out of breath, huddled on the ground, looking frightened and helpless, trying to win some sympathy with her weakness.
Shen Qingyuan stood in the hall, quietly watching the mother and daughter struggling to death, with a slightly cool curve on her lips: "Auntie, are you really innocent?"
She spoke slowly, her voice was clear but powerful: "Two days before the Haitang Banquet, you retreated to write a secret letter in your own hand, and sent your confidant butler to secretly send it to the East Palace through the back corner door, begging the prince to ruin my reputation during the banquet and support Qingrou to ascend to the throne. All the servants sweeping the floor and the doorkeeper in the back alleys of the mansion witnessed this. Do you still want to quibble?"
Every word and every sentence accurately exposed all Liu's pretense.
The old lady knew in her heart that Mrs. Liu was narrow-minded and ambitious. After hearing these words, the last trace of tolerance in her eyes was completely gone, and her eyes were cold and stern: "Mrs. Liu! I have wanted you to join the family for many years, raise a young daughter, and tolerate and give in many times. I didn't expect you to be so unrepentant, evil-minded, and repeatedly assassinated the eldest son!"
"The Prime Minister's Mansion cannot tolerate a vicious woman like you!"
Shen Jingshan was so angry that he immediately ordered in a deep voice: "From now on, the Liu family's stewardship will be removed, Ningxiang Courtyard will be banned, and no one will be allowed to step out of the courtyard! All close servants will be transferred out and placed under strict supervision, waiting for their release!"
With an order, the dust settled.
Mrs. Liu's face turned pale instantly, her legs went limp and she knelt on the ground. She raised her head in disbelief: "Master! No! I know I made a mistake, please forgive me!"
She has been in charge of the Prime Minister's Office for many years, and has long been accustomed to the power in her hands. Once she is banned and seizes power, she becomes a trapped animal in a cage, with no room for recovery. From now on, she will be at the mercy of others in the Prime Minister's Mansion, and will no longer have the capital to scheme against Shen Qingyuan.
But Shen Jingshan had made up his mind and refused to look at her again.
The servants immediately stepped forward, took Liu and Shen Qingrou, who were crying incessantly, and forcibly took them back to Ningxiang Court to be locked up.
Seeing the two people leaving in embarrassment, Shen Qingyuan felt no emotion at all.
This is just the beginning.
In her previous life, Mrs. Liu caused her biological mother to die tragically, took away her dowry, ruined her life, brought down the entire Shen family, and merely banned her and seized power, which was not worth the slightest bit of sin.
The old lady looked at the calm and indifferent granddaughter, filled with emotion, and softly comforted her: "Yuan'er, from now on, grandma will keep an eye on your family affairs in the house, and no one will dare to bully you anymore."
"Thank you, grandma." Shen Qingyuan knelt down and thanked her.
The storm in the main hall has ended, and the night is getting darker.
The lights in Tinglan Courtyard were brightly lit, and Chuntao brought warm soup with a face full of joy: "Miss, Aunt Liu has been seized of power and grounded. From now on, we will no longer have to be manipulated by her! Moreover, everyone in the capital is talking about the fact that the prince has done something dirty this time, and your majesty will definitely not forgive him lightly!"
Shen Qingyuan picked up the soup cup and gently blew the hot air away, her eyes deep and calm.
She knew that Prince Xiao Jingyu's position as heir apparent was already on the verge of collapse after this incident.
Far away in the palace, candles were brightly lit late at night.
The emperor looked at the memorial in his hand and listened to the guards reporting the whole story of the Begonia Banquet. Long Yan was furious and smashed the jade cup on the table with one palm.
"Absurd! As a prince, he is narrow-minded and vicious. He deliberately framed the legitimate daughter of a court official and brought disgrace to the royal family!"
That night, the imperial edict was drawn up: Prince Xiao Jingyu has failed in his moral conduct and will be banned from the East Palace. He will spend three months behind closed doors and be fined for one year. All personnel in the East Palace who have private wealth will be thoroughly investigated!
The news spread throughout the capital overnight, shaking the government and the public.
Everyone understood that this time, the prince was really in trouble.
And Shen Qingyuan, the prime minister's daughter-in-law, who has made a comeback and made every move, has completely changed her humble destiny that everyone can bully.
